visual.title: A field with no divergence
visual.caption: The saddle field has zero divergence, so it is a pure curl of something. The streamlines close around the saddle rather than piling up, which is what allows a vector potential.

predict.question: A vector potential A for a field F satisfies:
predict.explain: A vector potential is defined by F = curl A. This is possible exactly when div F = 0, and here div F = 1 − 1 = 0.
